title: Repair authors
description: Who made a repair and what they were handed. Provenance rather than proof of independence: the ceiling is recorded in each entry rather than hidden.

disposition.description: The disposition this repair consumed, recorded as its shape rather than as a copy of the rule. **Required on write** — the writer refuses a repair whose finding has no disposition, so no new record can lack it — and tolerated on read, because the records written before this field existed are judged by the rule they were written under rather than refused by a rule they could not have known.
